parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The filter conditions. A logical AND relationship exists between multiple filter conditions.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return for a paged query. The default value is **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is **100**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
